statusMessage: At 21:26 in Saint Oda Archive, Pastor Elias verifies Petra Dahl's identity and places Annika Ravn's sealed deposit directly into her hands. Petra opens it in Erik's presence. Annika's note says her promised Eidolon evidence is real but incomplete, warns that the brass cylinder was a decoy, and directs Petra toward archive pages that do not belong and a ledger that conceals its nature.

evidence.title: The Saint Vigga Drowning
evidence.summary: Hydrographer Dr. Annika Ravn, 41, was found dead and wet beneath the storm bell inside Saint Vigga's dry locked chamber at 20:18.

evidence.title: Handwritten camera-isolation docket
evidence.summary: A handwritten Thursday docket orders terminal cameras two and four offline from 18:29 to 18:36 for a 'union inspection.' The access-alert register records both outages, but the surrounding operational records contain no corresponding formal work order.

evidence.title: Seven-minute camera gap
evidence.summary: Jesper disabled terminal cameras two and four from 18:29 to 18:36 on Nils Rask's instruction.

evidence.title: Thursday ferry-company vehicle register
evidence.summary: A certified copy of North Channel Ferries' Thursday vehicle register, listing registrations, vehicle classes, assigned departments, and recorded status. It has not yet been compared with the service-lane sighting or workshop records.

evidence.title: Annika's sealed note to Petra
evidence.summary: Annika tells Petra that the promised Eidolon evidence is real but that her account was incomplete. She warns that the brass cylinder was a decoy, points toward archive pages that do not belong and a ledger that conceals its nature, and insists Petra account for Annika's own part in 1995 before publishing.
